Class ExecutionDebuggerResource

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.debugger.api.ExecutionDebuggerResource
@Path("/api/v1/debug/projects/{projectId}/executions/{executionId}") @Produces("application/json") public class ExecutionDebuggerResource extends Object
Optional debug endpoints that aggregate execution events and telemetry for UI troubleshooting.
